title: The Impossible Assignment
subtitle: You are given an unfamiliar task, incomplete instructions, a short deadline, and no manual. You must figure out the problem and mobilize resources.

blocks.text: Do not read ahead. Write your first 90 seconds. What do you observe? What do you say? What do you verify? What do you do first?

OPTION D — Mobilize the right person
Likely immediate consequence: ______ What you gain: ______ What you miss: ______

The resourceful move is usually not the cleverest sentence. It is the action that improves the quality of the situation: reduce heat, increase clarity, protect safety, find evidence, identify ownership, and create a next step. Adapt the order to the stakes.

items: Can I use the core tools from LEVEL 3 — BECOME RESOURCEFUL under pressure?
Can I explain what not to do?
Can I adapt rather than follow a checklist blindly?
Can I create evidence of capability in real life?

blocks.text: Listen, read rooms, communicate clearly, negotiate, and handle conflict with humanity.

WHAT YOU CAN DO AFTER THIS LEVEL
LEVEL 4 — I can handle people.
1 HOUR: complete two lessons and one Bad Room. MASTERY: complete all lessons, the boss fight, and one real-world capstone.
